@copilot+claude-opus-4.6 ci test 还有很多报错。AssertionError: expected { …(11) } to not have property "trustedOrigins"

> @copilot+claude-opus-4.6 ci test 还有很多报错。AssertionError: expected { …(11) } to not have property "trustedOrigins"

Fixed in `3042cf5`. The `trustedOrigins` tests were out of sync with the auto-default `http://localhost:*` behavior added in PR #1152. Updated both tests to verify the expected default value instead of asserting the property is absent. All 77 plugin-auth tests pass now.

Note: `@objectstack/studio#test` has pre-existing failures on the `main` branch (CRUD pagination counts, metadata type expectations) — those are unrelated to this PR.

> fix ./content/docs/getting-started/architecture.mdx.js:410:1
> Module not found: Can't resolve 'lucide-react'
> ...

Fixed in `8ea42ee`. The MDX content files in `content/docs/` import `lucide-react` icons, but Turbopack resolves modules starting from the file's directory — which can't reach `apps/docs/node_modules/`. Added `turbopack.resolveAlias` in `apps/docs/next.config.mjs` to alias `lucide-react` to the app's local installation. Docs build now compiles successfully.

> @copilot+claude-opus-4.6  src/client.hono.test.ts (3 tests) 30253ms
>      ✓ should connect to hono server and discover endpoints 71ms
>      ✓ should create and retrieve data via hono 63ms...

Fixed in `5e0777e`. The `afterAll` hook was hanging because `kernel.shutdown()` awaits `pinoLogger.flush()`, whose callback may never fire in CI (worker-thread transport timing). Changed to race the shutdown against a 10s deadline so the hook always completes within the 30s vitest limit.
